name: Heart Breakerz 1g Pre-Roll
description:
Lineage: Runtz x Jealousy 

Type: Hybrid

Terpenes: Caryphyllene, Limonene, Linalool

Effect Notes: Relaxing, Content, and Uplifting

Aroma: Sweet, Orange, Spicy

Heartbreakerz is sweet, sour, and unforgettable. With notes of cherries and berries, this hybrid delivers a soothing high that’s perfect for stress relief. It’s the kind of strain you’ll fall for every time.
